data.text: Ledger correction: run 01KYVM8KY10HP90YNBXMQP8ZCV is an accidental duplicate of 01KYVM7700YAJX8HP2JCSJG5CW — repro traffic mistakenly sent to the live daemon while investigating a shim crash. Its one useful effect: it exposed that the daemon accepts finish_run from a principal holding no claim (note the empty claim ref on the duplicate). Filed as its own task.
